name: Generator incomer connection interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Places the generator incoming switching point at its assigned switchboard bus.
description: Places the generator incoming switching point at its assigned switchboard bus. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Generator feeder” at the input and “Generator-to-bus connection” at the output. Generator protection remains separately defined.
